comment: The allow-listed `type="module"` script `src` entries a T1 page may load (K0 §4.12 item 2: 'only type="module" scripts whose src is an allow-listed entry'). The mechanism is P35.50's; the entries are the UXK0-4 enhancement-kit rows' — each registers its emitted entry here when it lands. Empty until then: a T1 page shipping ANY script today fails closed.
